name: Orphans
overview: Scripture reveals God's special concern for orphans, portraying Him as their defender and protector who will gather them when earthly parents forsake them. The Bible commands believers not to afflict widows or fatherless children, emphasizing the responsibility to help those without natural guardians. The Lord is described as a father to the fatherless and a judge of widows, ensuring justice for the vulnerable and delivering those who have no one to help them.
